title: tc-uncertainty-mix
description:
Where an answer's uncertainty comes from: the mix of kinds with their shares and meanings and a reading of what to
do, beside a breakdown chart of the same mix per part of the answer.

sources.description: Where the uncertainty comes from: a part, a kind's key and an amount each

kinds.description: The kinds, in display order – defaultUncertaintyKinds by default

parts.description: The parts in display order – by first appearance in `sources` by default

partLabel.description: What a part is called, e.g. "Section" or "Claim"

hiddenKinds.description: Keys of the kinds hidden from the chart and the reading

subtitle.description: The line under the heading, e.g. the question the answer is to

part.description: The part of the answer it belongs to, e.g. "Timeline"

amount.description: How much uncertainty it adds, in any unit – shares are worked out from the sum

claim.description: The claim it comes from, if it's one claim

meaning.description: What it means, in a few words

advice.description: What to do about it, as a sentence

color.description: Segment colour, any CSS colour – keep it at 3:1 against the card in both themes
